Comments are used to explain the CSS code, and may help when you edit the
source code at a later date.

Comments are also used to temporarily disable sections of CSS code within a
stylesheet.
A CSS comment is placed inside the HTML <style> element, and starts with /* and ends with */:

blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text: You can add comments wherever you want in the code:

blocks.caption: Example

blocks.text: Even in the middle of a code line:

Comments can also span
multiple lines:
